description: This file defines an HTTPClient struct with methods for tracing, metrics, and status handling, specific to OpenTelemetry instrumentation for HTTP clients.

classes.name: HTTPClient
classes.description: A struct for managing HTTP client tracing and metrics, including request/response attributes and status handling.

methods.name: NewHTTPClient
methods.description: Initializes a new HTTPClient with request body size and duration metrics.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Returns the status code and message based on HTTP response code.

methods.name: RequestTraceAttrs
methods.description: Generates trace attributes for an outgoing HTTP request.

methods.name: ResponseTraceAttrs
methods.description: Generates trace attributes for an HTTP response.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Determines the attribute key-value pair for the HTTP method.

methods.name: MetricAttributes
methods.description: Creates metric attributes for an HTTP request, including method, host, port, protocol, and status.

methods.name: MetricOptions
methods.description: Returns metric options for a given set of attributes.

methods.name: RecordMetrics
methods.description: Records request size and duration metrics.

methods.name: TraceAttributes
methods.description: Provides trace attributes for a given host.

methods.name: scheme
methods.description: Determines the URL scheme (http or https) for a request.
